content_sections.heading: AIIMS Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download AIIMS Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (MEDICAL): MBBS / BVSc / BDS Degree or equivalent Project Research Scientist I (NON-MEDICAL): Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degree, in a relevant subject Data Entry Operator: Intermediate or 12th pass from a recognized board, with any diploma/course in computers, with 2 years' experience in data entry work

content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (MEDICAL): Maximum age 35 years Project Research Scientist I (NON-MEDICAL): Maximum age 35 years Data Entry Operator: Maximum age 28 years

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences New Delhi (AIIMS) for various project-based positions in the healthcare sector.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available under AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across different posts including Project Research Scientist-I (Medical), Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), and Data Entry Operator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 15 October 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through email. Candidates need to send their detailed resumes and supporting documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) position will receive a monthly salary of ₹92,300/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Data Entry Operator position must be Intermediate or 12th pass from a recognized board, possess a diploma/course in computers, and have 2 years of experience in data entry work.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for any of the posts, making it free to apply for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised positions involves an interview through which eligible and qualified candidates will be shortlisted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the maximum age limit for Project Research Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) and Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) positions is set at 35 years.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates send their application resumes?
faq.answer: Candidates can send their complete resumes and required documents by email to [email protected] on or before the specified closing date.
